name: Spider, Albino Cave
body:
This tiny hunting spider is about the size of a man’s fist. It is pallid white, often with irregular light brown blotches on its abdomen, which helps it blend in with the toadstools and fungus which is its home. The albino cave spider normally feeds on normal and dire rats, but it attacks anything that comes within range.

Albino Cave Spider
CR 1/2

XP 200
N Tiny vermin
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 16, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +1 natural, +2 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2; Ref +4; Will +0
Immune vermin traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 10 ft
Melee bite +6 (1d3–3 plus poison)
Space 2 1/2 ft.; Reach 2 1/2 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 4, Dex 18, Con 10, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 3
Base Atk +0; CMB +2; CMD 9
Feats Weapon FinesseB
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+12 jump), Climb +12, Stealth +16; Racial Modifiers +8 to Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth; use Dex to modify Climb

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Constitution damage; cure 1 save.

The save DC is Constitution-based and includes a +4 racial bonus.

ECOLOGY

Environment underground
Organization solitary or nest (2–20)
Treasure standard
